notes: rustre-symbols-dwarf is an internal DWARF parsing library (ELF section table walk, .debug_abbrev, .debug_info CU/DIE walk, .debug_str/line_str/str_offsets resolution, .debug_line state machine, type/var/subprogram extraction, location expressions, call frame info, split-DWARF). No MCP tool in `rustre-mcp` directly surfaces these primitives (grep over crates/rustre-mcp for 'dwarf' / 'symbols_dwarf' / 'rustre_symbols_dwarf' returned 0 hits). The crate is consumed indirectly by higher-level analysis (loader/decompiler) when an ELF with DWARF is opened. No ELF+DWARF sample exists in the repository (no samples/hello_dwarf, no *.elf, no *.so under tracked paths; validator smoke test reports baseline_missing). End-to-end MCP vs validator comparison on a real DWARF blob therefore cannot be executed in this environment.

tests.name: decode_uleb(0xe5 0x8e 0x26)
tests.mcp_tool: (none - LEB128 decoders are pure-math internals not exposed by MCP)

summary: Pure-math primitives (LEB128 encode/decode, DW_TAG/DW_FORM constant tables) round-trip on the standalone validator and match DWARF v5 spec exactly. End-to-end DWARF parsing (sections, abbrev, CU walk, subprograms, variables, types, line program) cannot be cross-checked against MCP because (a) rustre-mcp exposes no tool that surfaces rustre-symbols-dwarf primitives, and (b) no ELF+DWARF sample exists in the repository. No mismatches surfaced; no crate modification required. Parallels the rustre-arch-mips comparison report (internal pure-math crate, no MCP surface, no sample).
